$comment: Shared by src/index.ts and scripts/anvil_costs.py. Price = tier base + perEnchantment x enchantment count; items are pinned at half the price (rounded up), so an item + item combine pays it once. Every enchantment's anvil_cost is cut by enchantmentDiscount (rounded, at least 1). An item's tier is the one with a prefix matching its id (with a kind, e.g. diamond_ + sword); anything else gets the default base. No item may match two tiers, and every base must be an integer >= 1 (the build checks both).
